# PulsarOS Core Whitelist — 26 cores for Allwinner H618 (Cortex-A53 × 4)
# Based on ArkOS/R36S compatibility (RK3326-class performance)
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

# ── Nintendo (9) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fceumm            # NES — fast, stable
snes9x            # SNES — best compatibility
gambatte          # Game Boy / GBC — accurate, lightweight
mgba              # GBA — accurate, good performance
melonds           # Nintendo DS
mupen64plus_next  # Nintendo 64 — most compatible
mednafen_pce_fast # PC Engine / TurboGrafx-16

# ── Sega (5) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
smsplus_gx        # Master System / Game Gear
genesis_plus_gx   # Mega Drive / Genesis / Sega CD
picodrive         # Sega 32X / Mega Drive (alternative)

# ── Sony (2) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pcsx_rearmed      # PlayStation 1 — MIPS JIT, great on ARM
ppsspp            # PSP — not all games full speed

# ── Arcade / Neo Geo (2) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fbneo             # Final Burn Neo (Neo Geo, CPS1/2/3, arcade)
mame2003_plus     # MAME 2003+ (broader arcade compatibility)

# ── Atari (4) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
stella            # Atari 2600
handy             # Atari Lynx
prosystem         # Atari 7800
atari800          # Atari 8-bit computers

# ── Other Systems (4) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
bluemsx           # MSX / MSX2
mednafen_wswan    # WonderSwan / WonderSwan Color
mednafen_pokemini # Pokemon Mini
puae              # Amiga (PUAE emulator)

# ── Engines (2) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
scummvm           # SCUMM adventure games
prboom            # Doom engine (PrBoom)
